active_phase.immediate_objective: A2 closes the residual radius ownership pass 2 disclosed but was not authorized to touch, and bounds the coverage movement that closing it made visible. RESULT. (1) All 97 Tailwind radius utility classes were removed from the 13 screens that carried them - rounded 15, rounded-lg 34, rounded-xl 44, rounded-2xl 1, rounded-full 3 - and the geometry moved into canonical declarations. TAILWIND_RADIUS_UTILITY_COUNT and TAILWIND_RADIUS_UTILITY_FILE_COUNT are both 0 across all 66 screens. Tailwind is no longer a second application-radius owner and css/tokens.css is the only radius owner inside js/screens. (2) The two named radius constants in pedido-detail-events.js, MOVEMENT_MODAL_RADIUS '6px' and MOVEMENT_SURFACE_RADIUS '4px', were canonicalized to var(--rv-radius), so a constant holds a token and never a literal. (3) Every radius-property gate is zero: UIC-001 0/0, UIC-002 0/0, UIC-007 0 blocking, UIC-010 0/0, UIC-011 0, UIC-009 debt 322 unchanged, out-of-enum explicit declarations 0, out-of-enum radius constants 0, no new alias, no local radius token, no waiver or suppression, no button with pill geometry, all semantic pills on --rv-radius-pill, no elongated track or bar treated as a circle, the 38 resolving aliases untouched as UIC-009 debt. Detector 1.0.3, contract hash unchanged, application inventory 66. (4) FIVE SCREENS MOVED FULL -> PARTIAL BECAUSE A2 MADE PREVIOUSLY INVISIBLE GEOMETRY OBSERVABLE, NOT BECAUSE ANYTHING REGRESSED. pedido-edit.js, pedido-insumos-distribuicao.js, pedido-itens-edit.js, pedido-parciais-admin.js and pedido-tracking-admin.js held their whole geometry in Tailwind class tokens, so declaration_sites was 0 and the detector had nothing to evaluate; FULL there meant invisible, not conforming. They now declare 12, 10, 16, 9 and 6 canonical values respectively and each honestly produces exactly one UIC-008 COVERAGE_GAP / ACTION_ROW_UNPROVEN finding. This is an observability increase, not a product, detector or radius regression. (5) The complete measured delta against published checkpoint 2114191 is exactly 5 findings added and 0 removed, all UIC-008 / coverage / ACTION_ROW_UNPROVEN on exactly those five paths; UIC-008 coverage 37 -> 42 and NO OTHER RULE MOVED AT ALL; blocking stays 111, debt stays 322, inventory stays 66, UNSUPPORTED stays 0. Accepted coverage is exactly FULL 23 / PARTIAL 44 / UNSUPPORTED 0. (6) Total UIC-008 population is now 0 blocking and 42 coverage gaps. NO data-card-actions MARKER WAS ADDED IN A2 and the five newly visible action rows were deliberately not inspected or corrected; all 42 gaps remain owned by the future dedicated alignment pass, which must reconcile the whole corpus rather than only the five newly visible files. (7) The Pass-1 test contract was corrected: its test 12b asserted a global PARTIAL <= 40 ceiling, which mechanically froze repository-wide detector reach at the pass-1 checkpoint and would have blocked every later property pass from making previously invisible declarations observable. It now asserts the invariants pass 1 actually owns - UNSUPPORTED 0, UIC-001 blocking/coverage/total 0, all 66 files inventoried - and the repository-wide delta proof moved to the A2 focused suite, where tests 21 through 21g pin it against 2114191 so a sixth gap, a different reason or any other rule movement fails loudly. (8) A2 also promoted two screens to declared semantic pills: pedido-itens-edit.js (2 sites) and pedido-tracking-admin.js (1 site) gained data-ui-pill because their rounded-full utilities became explicit var(--rv-radius-pill) declarations that would otherwise have produced new UIC-010 findings. The marker population moved 6 -> 8 files and 6 -> 9 sites; the exact-carrier-set equality guard still binds, and the measured delta confirms zero UIC-010 findings were added or removed. (9) A3 CLOSED THE LAST REACHABLE SHARED-RUNTIME RADIUS OWNER, so js/ui.js is no longer deferred debt. The architect ruled that the radius property is evaluated over the RENDERED FIRST-PARTY PRODUCT SURFACE, not over files located under js/screens/, and that a first-party shared primitive creating application controls is inside the material pass-2 boundary. A complete pre-write inventory of the whole first-party runtime - all 100 local scripts index.html loads, plus css/tokens.css, css/responsive.css and index.html itself - found 11 Tailwind radius utilities across 3 shared files and 2 out-of-enum declarations in 2 more; 13 sites in total, every one mechanically classifiable, no category E, and no out-of-enum radius in either stylesheet. Treatment: eight js/ui.js sites (toast, modal card, modal cancel, modal save, textInput, selectInput, dataTable wrapper and the pageHeader action button) to var(--rv-radius); three classification badges in js/badges.js and js/pedido-ui.js to var(--rv-radius), preserving their exact 4px geometry; the floating import button in js/documents-ingestor-import-ui.js 6px to var(--rv-radius); and the 9x9 timeline dot in js/document-links-surface-ui.js, a true circle, 50% to var(--rv-radius-pill). TAILWIND_RADIUS_UTILITY_COUNT_IN_PRODUCT_RUNTIME, its file count, OUT_OF_ENUM_RUNTIME_RADIUS_COUNT and OUT_OF_ENUM_RUNTIME_RADIUS_CONSTANT_COUNT are all 0, guarded by section 22 of the pass-2 focused suite over every script the application really loads, with non-vacuity fixtures for every utility spelling, explicit style strings, style.borderRadius and named constants. css/tokens.css is NOW THE SINGLE APPLICATION-RADIUS OWNER. The detector baseline is BYTE-IDENTICAL to 076be26: 0 findings added, 0 removed, every summary identical, FULL 23 / PARTIAL 44 / UNSUPPORTED 0, UIC-008 coverage 42 - because none of these files is in the 66-file screen inventory. Runtime proof at 1440x900 deviceScaleFactor 1, cold and warm: toast, modal card, modal cancel, modal save, textInput, selectInput and the dataTable wrapper each resolve to 4px; 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 failed local requests, 0 unresolved custom properties, 0 horizontal overflow, 0 out-of-enum radii, 0 pill-shaped buttons; focus, disabled, native select behaviour, modal lifecycle and copy all unchanged. They never reach the DOM and a custom property does not resolve in console styling, so rewriting them would break the styling rather than canonicalize it. The guard excludes them by paren-balanced console call detection, never by path and never by an ignore list, and asserts that exact set of three so the exclusion cannot widen. (11) LEFT OPEN FOR AN ARCHITECT DECISION, NOT DECIDED BY A3: badgeTipo, badgeStatus and pedidoStatusBadge are classification badges whose geometry is ordinary 4px rather than pill. D6.1 scopes --rv-radius-pill to semantic pills and true circles, so an argument exists that they should become pills; A3 closed ownership and preserved geometry exactly.
